description: Available balance, this month's spend, top-ups and movements.

kpi.balanceHint: Credits left to launch scans. The balance carries no discount: the discount applies to purchases, not to what you already have.
kpi.spentThisMonthHint: Scans launched since the first of the month.

kpi.equivalentHint: Exact equivalent at the list price of one credit. Not an estimate: a balance is not resold, so it carries no discount.
kpi.estimateHint: Exact equivalent at the list price of one credit. Not an estimate: a balance is not resold, so it carries no discount.

packs.title: Top up credits
packs.caption: Payment is handled by the external provider; the card never touches us.
packs.emptyCaption: The commercial catalog is defined on the server. If it is empty, the platform administrator has to configure it before anyone can buy.
packs.redirectNotice: You are leaving the platform to complete the payment.
packs.customCaption: Any amount between the minimum and the maximum.
packs.customHint: The minimum covers the cost of the payment session.
packs.customInvalid: Enter an amount between {{min}} and {{max}} credits.

ledger.title: Movements
ledger.caption: Every row is a ledger entry. The balance is never edited, only summed.
ledger.empty: No movements on this account yet

states.purchaseError: The payment could not be opened. The payment provider did not respond.

payment.paid: Payment received. The balance updates as soon as the provider confirms the charge.
payment.cancelled: You cancelled the payment. Nothing was charged.
payment.subscriptionPaid: Subscription active. The Pro plan has been applied to this workspace.

plan.subscriptionCaption: Access to Pro features, with priority in the support queue and urgent tickets.
plan.currentPlanNotice: This workspace is already on the Pro plan. The subscription is active.
plan.upgrade: You are already on the best available plan. Enterprise is arranged with the team.

proBenefits.volume: The whole volume discount ladder, from $10.
proBenefits.history: Longer scan history and report export.

volume.title: Buy in volume
volume.caption: The more you spend, the less each credit costs. The server applies the discount: the price you see is the price you pay.
volume.howItWorks: The bracket is decided by what you spend, not by the credits. Crossing a threshold makes the balance jump upwards: going from $250 to $251 is 28 more credits, not one.
volume.maxReached: You have reached the catalogue maximum. For larger volumes, talk to the team.
volume.barLabel: Discount ladder in {{count}} brackets. The active bracket is number {{position}}.
volume.noPosition: none, there is no amount yet
volume.savingsExplainer: The discount applies to this purchase, not to your current balance. The credits you already have keep their list price.
volume.creditsNote: The balance jumps at each threshold: spending one dollar more in the 15% bracket is 65 more credits, not one.
